title: The Muppets
tagline: Put on a show. Put on the kettle.
about: Walter, Gary and Mary get the Muppets back together to save their old theatre from an oil baron.

salt flakes100ml tomato sauceCut the potatoes into thick fries, rinse and dry.Fry in the vegetable oil at 140°C until soft.Rest the fries.Fry again in the oil at 190°C until crisp.Toss with sea salt crisscross, stuffed with cheddar, mozzarella and garlic chive butter, baked until bubbling for everyone manning the phones.Cut a cob loaf in a crisscross pattern about 3cm apart, going deep but not through the base.Melt 100g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and a handful of chopped chives.Push 150g grated cheddar and 150g grated mozzarella into the cuts and spoon the garlic butter over.Wrap in foil and bake at 180°C for 15 minutes, then open the foil and bake 10 minutes more until the cheese bubbles.Put it in the middle of the table and pull apart.MainsSteak frites with bearnaiseSeared sirloin, thin fries and tarragon bearnaise sauceHow to make it1kg potatoes1 L vegetable oil, for frying4 sirloin steaks3 tbsp white wine vinegar3 tbsp tarragon, chopped2 egg yolks150g butter, meltedsalt and pepper, to tasteCut the potatoes into thin fries.Fry twice in the vegetable oil until crisp.Season the steaks with salt and pepper and sear.Rest the steaks.Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon.Whisk in the egg yolks over gentle heat.Slowly add the melted butter, whisking.Serve the steak over the fries.Mary's anniversary stuffed chickenMary's anniversary dinner in Los AngelesHow to
